title: Lekishi chapter manifest
description: historical/chapters/<id>.yaml: what a chapter is called, the window it opens on, its story as an ordered list of event and relationship ids, and the owner's approval. The approval pins a digest of the manifest and every record and source it reaches; `pnpm approvals` shows what changed since the last approval and prints the digest. The owner writes the approval; no one else does.

steps.description: The story in presentation order, which is not a claim that one step preceded or caused another. Each step is an event or relationship id with its caption: `- akimeya-landfall-753: The landfall at 秋妻屋浦`.

include.description: Records the chapter publishes that its story does not step through, such as a relationship the map draws as an arc.
